NOTE: BBC News (14 Jul 2026) — "Row after Tory bid to make Burnham face MPs before autumn fails." Commons began six-week summer recess Thursday 16/17 July; not due to return until 1 September. Labour (majority 150+) blocked a Tory opposition-day motion to delay recess so Burnham could face MPs. Shadow Commons leader Jesse Norman: government "could not bear the idea of a new prime minister facing any scrutiny before September." Speaker Sir Lindsay Hoyle can recall Parliament if the government asks. CORROBORATION: parliament.uk recess dates (Summer: rise 16/17 Jul, return 1 Sep 2026); BBC (Starmer final PMQs) — Burnham "not likely to take questions in Parliament until September." => Burnham's FIRST PMQs is NOT this Wednesday; scheduled for early September (2 Sep per The Sun, non-approved). APPROVED SOURCES: bbc.co.uk + parliament.uk.
